addons.name: Temperature
addons.description: The temperature outside now, as a meter from -5 C (empty) to 40 C (full). Updated every 15 minutes. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Rain chance
addons.description: The chance of rain in the coming hour, 0 to 100%. Glance before the washing goes out. Updated every 15 minutes. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: UV index
addons.description: The UV index now, from 0 to 11+ (full is extreme). Past half way is time for sunscreen. Updated every 15 minutes. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Wind
addons.description: The wind speed now, 0 to 60 km/h. Updated every 15 minutes. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Air quality
addons.description: The European air quality index outside: under 20 is good, 50 is poor, full (100) is extremely poor. Worth a look before opening the windows to air out the printer. Updated every 30 minutes. Air quality data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Ethereum, last 24 hours
addons.description: The change in the price of ether over the last day: half way is no change, full is up 10% or more, empty is down 10% or more. From CoinGecko, every 5 minutes.
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Aurora
addons.description: Greens and violets drifting slowly along the bar, like the northern lights.
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Ocean breathing
addons.description: A calm blue that rises and falls, slow enough to fall asleep to.
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Rainbow
addons.description: Every colour, rolling end to end.
addons.author: Panda State

addons.name: Police lights
addons.description: Red then blue, double flashes, the two halves of the bar taking turns.

addons.name: Bitcoin, last 24 hours
addons.description: A meter of the change in the price of bitcoin over the last day: half way is no change, full is up 10% or more, empty is down 10% or more. From CoinGecko, every 5 minutes.
